objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types that go through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short prefix code for the document type used in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, 4-digit consecutive number per document type included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: User-defined title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document, incremented on content or relevant attribute changes.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time span for validity check cycle, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period after invalidation before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope information printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client in a multi-client system in which the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document; subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment, subject to own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment, follows the main document release statuses.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary document object added to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document without affecting its current content or version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, processed via workflow to extend or revise validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document and initiate archiving when the document has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restricted to Business Admin Group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person in the system who can hold roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator or reader and participates in workflow steps.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used for assigning read authorizations, distribution and role-based access control.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons maintained per document who are informed or requested for acknowledgement upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that orchestrates approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature captured from a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational entity such as a department or location that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation or search report providing filtered information about documents and their statuses.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g. Status Report, Search for Documents, Status Report for Acknowledgement).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator, Review, Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first workflow step (Creator) with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step positively, finalizing the document approval.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling subsequent tasks.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment's content is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is extended through the validity extension workflow, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and start the override workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A document is declared out of force (invalidated), revoking all rights except archive group access.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A Business Admin Group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to users or user groups for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of the released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version is checked and released through the translation approval workflow.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, archived documents are physically deleted from the system.
